description: This file implements a sample client to report test case results via XML-RPC to a Testlink server. It defines a function for executing test case reports, constructs data payloads, and interacts with the XML-RPC client library.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: A generic empty class used to dynamically assign properties for context and execution data.

classes.name: IXR_Client
classes.description: An XML-RPC client class used to communicate with the test management server.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Sends a test case result report to the server via XML-RPC, preparing data from parameters and context objects.
